title: MatchWise | Unified Monitoring HU
description: Unified monitoring for Oracle Cloud infrastructure, Render backend availability, Vercel frontend availability, Pino HTTP application logs, and Render log collector health. Render and Vercel host CPU/RAM metrics are not collected. Probe freshness and sample counts, optional health-check exclusion, endpoint summary, HTTP log freshness, deployment annotations and log drilldowns. Supabase database resource, connection-capacity, transaction, PostgREST pool and disk I/O monitoring.

panels.title: MatchWise · Üzemeltetési áttekintés
panels.description: High-level view of all currently collected monitoring data.

options.content:
**Elérhetőség → forgalom → kapacitás.** Kék: frontend · Narancs: backend · Zöld: adatbázis · Lila: Oracle.

Hiányzó adat ≠ nulla. Az elérhetőség HTTP-próbát vagy metrikakapcsolatot jelent; a részletek lent lenyithatók.

panels.title: Frontend · HTTP-próba
panels.description: Legutóbbi HTTP-próba háromperces ablakban, csak aktuálisan sikeres exporter scrape mellett. A próba percenként fut. Sikertelen HTTP-próba: piros; hiányzó vagy nem gyűjthető próba: nincs adat. Nem folyamatos rendelkezésreállási SLA.

panels.title: Backend · HTTP-próba
panels.description: Legutóbbi HTTP-próba háromperces ablakban, csak aktuálisan sikeres exporter scrape mellett. A próba percenként fut. Sikertelen HTTP-próba: piros; hiányzó vagy nem gyűjthető próba: nincs adat. Nem folyamatos rendelkezésreállási SLA.

panels.title: Adatbázis · PostgreSQL-kapcsolat
panels.description: pg_up reports whether the PostgreSQL exporter connected successfully. The card requires a successful Metrics API scrape. Application auth checks are tracked in the authentication section.

panels.title: Oracle · Metrikagyűjtés
panels.description: Last Prometheus scrape of Oracle VM host metrics.

panels.title: Frontend · HTTP-próba kora
panels.description: A legutóbbi tényleges HTTP-próbaminta kora a háromperces ablakban. Nem böngészőforgalom vagy telemetriacsomag-kor.

panels.title: Backend · HTTP-próba kora
panels.description: A legutóbbi tényleges HTTP-próbaminta kora a háromperces ablakban. Nem böngészőforgalom vagy telemetriacsomag-kor.

panels.title: Backend-napló · Sikeres gyűjtés kora
panels.description: A naplógyűjtő utolsó sikeres futásának kora másodpercben. Nem az utolsó üzleti kérés kora.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Metrikagyűjtés
panels.description: Prometheus scrape status for the selected Supabase target. UP confirms the Metrics API scrape. PostgreSQL reachability is shown separately.

panels.title: Oracle · CPU (%)
panels.description: Oracle VM CPU utilization from Node Exporter.

panels.title: Oracle · Memória (%)
panels.description: Oracle VM memory utilization from Node Exporter.

panels.title: Oracle · Gyökérlemez (%)
panels.description: Root filesystem utilization on the Oracle VM.

panels.title: Backend · HTTP 5xx · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: HTTP 5xx responses found in Pino application logs within the selected dashboard time range. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: Backend · Kérések / perc · 5 perces átlag
panels.description: Naplózott backend HTTP-kérések, ötperces átlag percenkénti egységben. A Forgalom és Útvonal szűrők érvényesek. Az összehasonlító dashboard ezzel szemben kifejezetten az API-csoportokra szűr.

targets.expr: sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 60

panels.title: Backend · Feldolgozási idő P50 / P95 · 15 perc
panels.description: Naplózott alkalmazásfeldolgozási idő P50 és P95, gördülő 15 perces ablakban. Nem a HTTP-próba és nem a böngésző teljes válaszideje.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [15m]) by (job)

quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [15m]) by (job)

panels.title: HTTP-próbák időtartama · Frontend és backend
panels.description: Ugyanazon Oracle-gépről indított HTTP-próbák, közös másodperces skálán. DNS-, kapcsolat- és hálózati időt is tartalmaznak; nem a böngészőben mért API-válaszidők és nem backend-feldolgozási idők.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Kapcsolatkeret (%)
panels.description: Sum of exported PostgreSQL connections across database roles divided by the exported maximum connection limit. Includes Supabase internal service connections. Display thresholds are 70% and 85%.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Adatlemez (%)
panels.description: Allocated /data filesystem utilization, using space available to unprivileged users. Display thresholds are 80% and 90%. This measures filesystem capacity. Plan storage allowances must be checked separately in Supabase. A missing /data mount remains No data.

panels.title: Adatbázis · CPU (%)
panels.description: Non-idle CPU time averaged across database host cores over five minutes. A new scrape target needs multiple samples before a rate can be computed. Display thresholds are 80% and 90%.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Memória (%)
panels.description: Database host memory usage based on MemAvailable / MemTotal, allowing for reclaimable cache. Display thresholds are 80% and 90%.

panels.title: Oracle · Üzemidő
panels.description: Seconds since the Oracle VM last booted.

panels.title: Oracle · Elérhető memória
panels.description: Available system memory, excluding reclaimable/cached memory that is in use.

panels.title: Oracle · Szabad lemezterület
panels.description: Available storage on the Oracle VM root filesystem.

panels.title: Oracle · Rendszerterhelés · 1 perc
panels.description: One-minute system load average.

panels.title: Oracle · CPU (%)
panels.description: Five-minute moving average of Oracle CPU utilization.

panels.title: Oracle · Memória (%)
panels.description: Available-based memory utilization, percent of installed RAM.

panels.title: Oracle · Gyökérlemez (%)
panels.description: Root filesystem used space percentage.

panels.title: Oracle · Lemezforgalom
panels.description: Read and write throughput of block devices. Diskstats are recorded by Node Exporter.

panels.title: Oracle · Hálózati forgalom
panels.description: Receive/transmit throughput from non-loopback network interfaces (Docker and veth devices excluded).

panels.title: Oracle · Rendszerterhelés · 1 / 5 / 15 perc
panels.description: Linux 1-, 5- and 15-minute system load averages; a load average is not CPU usage percent.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Nyitott kapcsolatok
panels.description: Exported PostgreSQL connection count summed across database roles. Includes internal Supabase services and pooled server connections. This counts database connections, independently of application logins.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Adatméret
panels.description: Database size in bytes, summed across exported databases except template0 and template1. Includes database objects such as tables and indexes. WAL and filesystem usage are separate measures.

panels.title: Adatbázis · CPU és memória (%)
panels.description: Database host CPU and memory utilization for the selected Supabase target.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Fájlrendszerek telítettsége
panels.description: Root and data filesystem usage shown separately. The root filesystem contains operating-system files. The data filesystem holds database storage. Values describe allocated filesystem capacity.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Kapcsolatok szerepkörönként
panels.description: Connection counts by PostgreSQL role, such as authenticator and supabase_auth_admin. Useful for identifying which service consumes connection slots. Roles are database identities.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Lezárt és visszagörgetett tranzakciók
panels.description: Lezárt és visszagörgetett PostgreSQL-tranzakciók másodpercenként, ötperces átlagban. Belső szolgáltatások és más kliensek munkáját is tartalmazhatja; nem HTTP-kérésszám.

panels.title: Adatbázis · PostgreSQL puffer-találati arány
panels.description: Block hits / (block hits + block reads), calculated from five-minute rates. A zero denominator produces no ratio. PostgreSQL buffer cache hits exclude operating-system cache effects. Interpret changes alongside traffic and I/O, especially on a new database.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Ideiglenes fájlok írása
panels.description: Bytes per second written by queries to temporary files, for example when sorts or hashes spill to disk. Sustained growth alongside slow requests can indicate query or memory pressure.

panels.title: PostgREST · Kapcsolatra várakozó kérések
panels.description: Csak a PostgREST kapcsolatkészletére várakozó kérések. Nem az összes PostgreSQL-várakozás, zárolás vagy backendkérés.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Deadlockok és pool-időtúllépések / perc
panels.description: Ötperces eseményráta percenként. Deadlock és PostgREST-pool-időtúllépés külön sor. Visszagörgetés vagy együttmozgás önmagában nem támadásbizonyíték.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Lemezforgalom
panels.description: Disk throughput shown per device to avoid summing logical and physical layers together. Loop, RAM and removable-style devices are excluded.

panels.title: Adatbázis · Átlagos lemezműveleti idő
panels.description: Average read/write time per completed I/O over five minutes, per device. When no operations complete, the corresponding average has no value. Interpret alongside throughput and application latency.

panels.title: Backend · Legutóbbi HTTP-kód
panels.description: A legutóbbi, három percnél frissebb HTTP-próba mért értéke. Csak elérhető exporter mellett látszik. Az időtartam DNS-, kapcsolat- és hálózati időt is tartalmaz; nem backend-feldolgozási idő.

panels.title: Backend · Legutóbbi HTTP-próba időtartama
panels.description: A legutóbbi, három percnél frissebb HTTP-próba mért értéke. Csak elérhető exporter mellett látszik. Az időtartam DNS-, kapcsolat- és hálózati időt is tartalmaz; nem backend-feldolgozási idő.

panels.title: Backend · Mért próbák sikeraránya · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: A kiválasztott időszak tárolt HTTP-próbáinak sikeraránya. A mintaszám mellett értelmezendő; nem folyamatos üzemidő vagy szerződéses SLA. Hiányzó próbákból nem készül százalék.

panels.title: Backend · Legutóbbi HTTP-próba ideje
panels.description: Timestamp of the latest stored backend probe sample.

panels.title: Backend · Mért próbák száma · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: Counts actual stored probe samples in the selected range, per URL. Display points in a range graph may repeat these samples.

panels.title: Backend · Exporter scrape
panels.description: A value of 1 means Prometheus could scrape the probe exporter. HTTP probe success is shown separately.

panels.title: Backend · HTTP-próbák időtartama
panels.description: Range evaluation can repeat the latest stored sample at multiple display points. Sampling interval is one minute. Use Actual probe samples for the number of independent measurements.

panels.title: Backend · HTTP-próbák eredménye
panels.description: Range evaluation can repeat the latest stored sample at multiple display points. Sampling interval is one minute. Use Actual probe samples for the number of independent measurements.

panels.title: Frontend · Legutóbbi HTTP-kód
panels.description: A legutóbbi, három percnél frissebb HTTP-próba mért értéke. Csak elérhető exporter mellett látszik. Az időtartam DNS-, kapcsolat- és hálózati időt is tartalmaz; nem backend-feldolgozási idő.

panels.title: Frontend · Legutóbbi HTTP-próba időtartama
panels.description: A legutóbbi, három percnél frissebb HTTP-próba mért értéke. Csak elérhető exporter mellett látszik. Az időtartam DNS-, kapcsolat- és hálózati időt is tartalmaz; nem backend-feldolgozási idő.

panels.title: Frontend · Mért próbák sikeraránya · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: A kiválasztott időszak tárolt HTTP-próbáinak sikeraránya. A mintaszám mellett értelmezendő; nem folyamatos üzemidő vagy szerződéses SLA. Hiányzó próbákból nem készül százalék.

panels.title: Frontend · Legutóbbi HTTP-próba ideje
panels.description: Timestamp of the latest stored frontend probe sample.

panels.title: Frontend · Mért próbák száma · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: Counts actual stored frontend probe samples in the selected range, per URL.

panels.title: Frontend · Exporter scrape
panels.description: A value of 1 means Prometheus could scrape the probe exporter.

panels.title: Frontend · HTTP-próbák időtartama
panels.description: Frontend HTTP probe duration as observed from the Oracle VM.

panels.title: Frontend · HTTP-próbák eredménye
panels.description: Success of each sampled frontend HTTP check.

panels.title: HTTP-kérések · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: Count of Pino HTTP request logs during the selected period. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range]))

panels.title: HTTP 4xx · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: Client error responses (HTTP 4xx) during the selected period. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: HTTP 5xx · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: Server error responses (HTTP 5xx) during the selected period. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: HTTP-hibaarány · 4xx és 5xx
panels.description: Share of Pino HTTP requests with a 4xx or 5xx response. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0)) / (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Backend · HTTP 401 · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: Matching HTTP 401 responses in the selected period. May be an expected authentication rejection. Click to inspect.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode = 401 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: Backend · HTTP 404 · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: Matching HTTP 404 responses in the selected period. Click to inspect.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode = 404 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: Backend · Health-kérések · Kiválasztott időszak
panels.description: Health request count in the selected range, independent of Traffic and Route contains filters.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route=~"(/api/health|/health)" [$__range]))

panels.title: Backend · Időmérési minták · Utolsó 15 perc
panels.description: Number of matching logs with nonnegative numeric responseTimeMs in the P50/P95 rolling window.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | duration_ms >= 0 | __error__="" [15m]))

panels.title: Backend · HTTP-hibák / perc
panels.description: 4xx and 5xx HTTP errors per minute (five-minute rolling window). Zero is shown when there are no matching errors.

targets.expr: (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [5m])) or (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 0)) * 60

(sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [5m])) or (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 0)) * 60

panels.title: Backend · HTTP-státuszok · Gördülő 5 perc
panels.description: HTTP response code counts per five-minute rolling window.

targets.expr: sum by (statusCode) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" [5m]))

panels.title: Backend · Leggyakoribb naplózott útvonalak
panels.description: Top ten routes by HTTP request count in the selected time range, shown as one horizontal bar per route. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. The count field uses exact whole numbers. Click a bar through its tooltip to inspect the route logs.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (route) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | route != "" [$__range]))))

panels.title: Backend · Végpontösszesítő
panels.description: One row per HTTP method and logged route. Five instant Loki tables are joined on the combined method/route key. Shows exact request and error counts, selected-period P95 in milliseconds and numeric timing sample count. Missing timings remain empty. Traffic and Route contains apply. Click a Route to inspect logs.

targets.expr: sum by (method, route, endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range]))

(sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

(sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (endpoint)

sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | duration_ms >= 0 | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Sikeres belépések · 200
